note: Members the game-derived route maps link as a rename although the new member returns something else. port removes these pairs from its map before repairing, so a call no rule could rewrite safely stays a reported error instead of compiling with a changed meaning. Each entry names the evidence, read from the game's own classes.

changes.why: getMaxBuildHeight() was exclusive (minY + height); getMaxY() is inclusive (minY + height - 1). Rule level-height-max-y-exclusive rewrites the calls where getMaxY() + 1 binds the same way.
changes.evidence: Mojang's 26.1 client jar: LevelHeightAccessor.getMaxY() bytecode is getMinY() + getHeight() - 1

changes.why: Yarn's names for the same change: getTopY() was exclusive, getTopYInclusive() is one lower. Rule height-limit-top-y-exclusive rewrites the safe calls.
changes.evidence: Mojang's 26.1 client jar: LevelHeightAccessor.getMaxY() (yarn getTopYInclusive) is getMinY() + getHeight() - 1
